mpa-p01-v01.speaker: Poet (maṅgala)
mpa-p01-v01.question: What is first worshipped?
premises: Homage to the world-formed, beyond the world.
To ever-divine-shining, self with unending power.
mpa-p01-v01.inference: The maṅgala names its object twice: the formed world transcended, the shining self whose power does not end.

mpa-p01-v02.speaker: Poet (identity)
mpa-p01-v02.question: Who are you, who am I?
premises: You alone are you; I alone am I; you alone are; I am not at all.
I and you as both are not: where homage, homage, homage.
mpa-p01-v02.inference: Identity and non-identity both refused: neither you alone nor I alone, nor both — only homage where the question lands.

mpa-p01-v03.speaker: Poet (seeking)
mpa-p01-v03.question: What is found inside?
premises: Sought inside the body by me always — you as self, and never seen is the self.
Whatever is seen is you alone, that.
mpa-p01-v03.inference: Seeking finds no self to see: whatever is seen is you alone — the sought turns out to be the seer.

mpa-p01-v04.speaker: Poet (recognition)
mpa-p01-v04.question: What does the devotee declare?
premises: Of your devotee who well knows your form, now again.
Having seen you as the self's form: to you homage, to me homage.
mpa-p01-v04.inference: Recognition declared both ways: seen as self, homage goes to you and to me — knower and known each honored.

mpa-p01-v05.speaker: Poet (method-question)
mpa-p01-v05.question: What finesse remains?
premises: What going-finesse, what to be done, thus, from the root.
Of yours, made of your magic power: by what, in what, whence the dissolving.
mpa-p01-v05.inference: Method questioned to its root: given your magic-nature, what instrument, what place, what origin could dissolving have.

mpa-p01-v06.speaker: Poet (non-duality)
mpa-p01-v06.question: Is there duality?
premises: I, you; you, I — thus: no duality of us anywhere.
Only the wish to grasp samādhi: abiding of difference is just that.
mpa-p01-v06.inference: Non-duality asserted, difference explained away: what looks like abiding difference is only the wish to grasp samādhi.

mpa-p01-v07.speaker: Poet (speech)
mpa-p01-v07.question: Where do words go?
premises: You-I and so-on, so endless, ever in you, never find a place.
Words, then — whence the world.
mpa-p01-v07.inference: Speech finds no room in you: if even I-and-you-talk cannot stay, whence a world of words.
uncertainties: Print variant so yamityādi nūnaṃ tāni noted; edition so'nantāni kept.

mpa-p01-v08.speaker: Poet (enough)
mpa-p01-v08.question: What is enough?
premises: Enough of difference-talk: from chewing the sap of devotion to you.
All this is one, at peace — even to say so is shy.
mpa-p01-v08.inference: Enough of talking difference: devotion chewed to sap leaves all as one, at peace — and even saying so is shy.

mpa-p01-v09.speaker: Poet (expansion)
mpa-p01-v09.question: What when you expand, what when you withdraw?
premises: Your own form expanding — you and I and the whole world.
Born its withdrawal — neither you nor I nor world indeed.
mpa-p01-v09.inference: Expansion holds all three; withdrawal holds none: being and nonbeing of you, me, world turn on your play.

mpa-p01-v10.speaker: Poet (actor)
mpa-p01-v10.question: Who shines like an actor yet stays partless?
premises: Waking-dream-deep-sleep and the rest, holding as own rays.
By own will you shine like an actor — partless, yet in truth.
mpa-p01-v10.inference: States held as own rays: shining by own will like an actor, yet partless in truth.
uncertainties: Print naTavan kept byte-true (probable slip for naṭavat actor-like); gloss follows sense.

mpa-p02-v11.speaker: Poet (derivation)
mpa-p02-v11.question: Whose is all this?
premises: From your waking, his waking; from your sleep, his rest.
Hence all is of your nature: the world as real-unreal.
mpa-p02-v11.inference: Waking and sleep derived: his waking yours, his rest yours — hence all is of your nature, real-and-unreal.

mpa-p02-v12.speaker: Poet (exhaustion)
mpa-p02-v12.question: What use are rites for the formless?
premises: The tongue is tired in your name; the mind is tired in remembering you.
Of the formless, what meditation; of the qualityless, what name.
mpa-p02-v12.inference: Rites exhausted at the start: tired tongue, tired mind — meditation with no form to hold, name with no quality to name.

mpa-p02-v13.speaker: Poet (kutaḥ)
mpa-p02-v13.question: Where is the seat for the all-based?
premises: Where is summoning for the full; where a seat for the all-based.
Foot-water and respects for the clean; sipping for the pure.
mpa-p02-v13.inference: The kutaḥ series opens: summoning, seating, washing, sipping — each rite asked where, for whom without place.

mpa-p02-v14.speaker: Poet (kutaḥ)
mpa-p02-v14.question: What bath, garment, scent, jewel?
premises: What bath for the stainless; what garment for the world-bellied.
What scent for the unanointed; what jewel for the lovely.
mpa-p02-v14.inference: Adornment rites interrogated: no bath, no garment, no scent, no jewel where stainless, world-full, unanointed, lovely.

mpa-p02-v15.speaker: Poet (kutaḥ)
mpa-p02-v15.question: What thread, flowers, incense, lamp?
premises: Sacred thread for the propless; flowers for the desireless.
Incense for the noseless, lamp for the eyeless — what use.
mpa-p02-v15.inference: Offering rites interrogated: thread, flowers, incense, lamp — each without a receiver.
uncertainties: Print variant apraṇasya (for-breathless) noted; edition aghrāṇa (noseless) kept.

mpa-p02-v16.speaker: Poet (kutaḥ)
mpa-p02-v16.question: What offering, circumambulation, obeisance?
premises: Food-offering for the ever-content, betel for the Lord — whence.
Circumambulation for the endless, obeisance for the non-dual — whence.
mpa-p02-v16.inference: Honorific rites interrogated: food, betel, circling, bowing — all without a needy recipient.

mpa-p02-v17.speaker: Poet (kutaḥ)
mpa-p02-v17.question: How is the hymn enjoined?
premises: Whence waving-lights for the self-shining Lord.
How is a hymn enjoined for the Veda-unspeakable.
mpa-p02-v17.inference: Even praise interrogated: lights for the self-shining, hymn for the unspeakable — enjoined how.

mpa-p02-v18.speaker: Poet (kutaḥ)
mpa-p02-v18.question: How sending-off, how oblation?
premises: How is sending-off for the full, inside and out.
And how is oblation for the difference-free, everywhere.
mpa-p02-v18.inference: Farewell and fire-offering interrogated: no going out for the full, no difference for the fire.

mpa-p02-v19.speaker: Poet (kutaḥ)
mpa-p02-v19.question: What fee, libation, dismissal, pardon?
premises: Where is the fee for the full; libation for the ever-content.
Dismissal for the all-pervading; pardon for the unseen.
mpa-p02-v19.inference: Closing rites interrogated: fee, drink, dismissal, pardon — none owed where full, content, everywhere, unseen.

mpa-p02-v20.speaker: Poet (seal)
mpa-p02-v20.question: What then is worship?
premises: Just so, indeed, the highest worship, in all states, always.
With nondual mind, yoke the mind to God as Lord of all.
mpa-p02-v20.inference: The answer after twenty negations: nondual mind yoked to the Lord of all, in every state, always — that is the highest worship.

mpa-p01-v01.plain_english: Homage to the world-formed, whose form is beyond the world — to the ever-divine-shining, to the self of unending power.

mpa-p01-v02.plain_english: You alone are you; I alone am I. You alone are; I am not at all. As for you and me both being — where is there homage, homage?
mpa-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: tvaṃ tvamevāhamevāhaṃ tvamevāsi na cāsmyaham | ahaṃ tvamityubhau na sto yatra tasmai namo namaḥ

mpa-p01-v03.plain_english: Inside the body, sought by me always — you as self, and the self is never seen. Whatever is seen is you alone, that.
mpa-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: antardehe mayā nityaṃ tvamātmā ca gaveṣitaḥ | na dṛṣṭastvaṃ nacaivātmā yacca dṛṣṭaṃ tvameva tat

mpa-p01-v04.plain_english: Of your devotee who well knows your form, now again: having seen you as the self's form — to you homage, to me homage.
mpa-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktasya sajñātabhavadrūpasyatha me punaḥ | tvāmātmarūpaṃ samprekṣya tubhyaṃ mahyaṃ namo namaḥ

mpa-p01-v05.plain_english: What finesse of going is there, what should be done, thus, from the root? Of yours, made of your magic power — by what, in what, from where is the dissolving?
mpa-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: etadgacananaipuṇyaṃ yatkartavyetimūlayā | bhavanmāyātmanastasya kena kasmin kuto layaḥ

mpa-p01-v06.plain_english: I, you; you, I — thus there is no duality of us anywhere. Only the wish to grasp samādhi: that is what the abiding of difference is.
mpa-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ tvaṃ tvamahaṃ ceti bhinnatā nāvayoḥ kvacit | samādhigrahaṇecchāyā bhedasyāvasthitirhyasau

mpa-p01-v07.plain_english: You, I, and so on — so endless, ever in you, they find no room. Words, then — whence the world?
mpa-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: tvamahaṃ so'yamityādi so'nantāni sadā tvayi | na labhante cāvakāśaṃ vacanāni kuto jagat

mpa-p01-v08.plain_english: Enough of difference-talk. From chewing the sap of devotion to you — all this is one, at peace, though even to say so is shy.
mpa-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: alaṃ bhedānukathayā tvadbhaktirasacarvaṇāt | sarvamekamidaṃ śāntamiti vaktuṃ ca lajjate

mpa-p01-v09.plain_english: When your own form expands — you and I and the whole world. When its withdrawal is born — neither you, nor I, nor indeed the world.
mpa-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: tvatsvarūpe jṛmbhamāṇe tvaṃ cāhaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat | jāte tasya tirodhāne na tvaṃ nāhaṃ na vai jagat

mpa-p01-v10.plain_english: Waking, dreaming, deep sleep and the rest — holding them as your own rays. By your own will you shine like an actor, and yet you are partless in truth.
mpa-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: jāgratasvapnasuṣuptyādyā dhārayaṃśca nijāḥ kalāḥ | svecchayā bhāsi naṭavan niṣkalo'si ca tattvataḥḥ

mpa-p02-v11.plain_english: From your waking, his waking; from your sleep, his sleep. Hence all is of your nature: the world as real and unreal.
mpa-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: tvatprabodhāt prabodho'sya tvannidrāto layo'sya yat | atastvadātmakaṃ sarvaṃ viśva sadasadātmakam

mpa-p02-v12.plain_english: The tongue is tired of your name; the mind is tired of remembering you. For the formless, what meditation? For the qualityless, what name?
mpa-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: jihvā śrāntā bhavannāmni manaḥ śrāntaṃ bhavatsmṛtau | arūpasya kuto dhyāna nirguṇasya ca nāma kim

mpa-p02-v13.plain_english: For the full, whence summoning? For the all-based, whence a seat? For the clean, foot-water and respects? For the pure, sipping?
mpa-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasyāvāhanaṃ kutra sarvādhārasya cāsanam | svacchasya pādyamarghyañca śuddhasyācamanaṃ kutaḥ

mpa-p02-v14.plain_english: For the stainless, what bath? For the world-bellied, what garment? For the unanointed, what scent? For the lovely, what jewel?
mpa-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: nirmalasya kutaḥ snānaṃ vastraṃ viśvodarasya ca | nirlepasya kuto gandho ramyasyābharaṇaṃ kutaḥ

mpa-p02-v15.plain_english: The sacred thread for the propless; flowers for the desireless. Incense for the noseless, lamp for the eyeless — what use?
mpa-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: nirālambasyopavītaṃ puṣpaṃ nirvāsanasya ca | aghrāṇasya kuto dhūpaścakṣurhīnasya dīpakaḥ

mpa-p02-v16.plain_english: Food-offering for the ever-content, betel for the Lord — whence? Circumambulation for the endless, obeisance for the non-dual — whence?
mpa-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: nityatṛptasya naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca kuto vibhoḥ | pradakṣiṇamanantasyā'dvitīyasyaya kuto natiḥ

mpa-p02-v17.plain_english: Whence waving-lights for the self-shining Lord? How is a hymn enjoined for the Veda-unspeakable?
mpa-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: svayaṃ prakāśamānasya kuto nīrājanaṃ vibhoḥ | vedavācāmavedyasya kutaḥ stotraṃ vidhīyate

mpa-p02-v18.plain_english: How is there sending-off for the full, inside and out? And how is there oblation for the difference-free, everywhere?
mpa-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: antarbahiśca pūrṇasya kathamudvāsanaṃ bhavet | bhedahīnasya viśvatra kathaṃ ca havanaṃ bhavet

mpa-p02-v19.plain_english: Where is the fee for the full? Libation for the ever-content? Dismissal for the all-pervading? Pardon for the unseen?
mpa-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasya dakṣiṇā kutra nityatṛptasya tarpaṇam | visarjanaṃ vyāpakasyā'pratyakṣasya kṣamāpaṇam

mpa-p02-v20.plain_english: Just so, indeed, is the highest worship, in all states, always: with nondual mind, yoke the mind to God as Lord of all.
mpa-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: evameva parā pūjā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā | aikyabuddhayā tu sarveśe mano deve niyojayet

essence: Homage to the world-formed beyond the world, ever-shining self of unending power.
You alone, I alone; you are, I am not; both are not — only homage.
Seeking finds no self to see: whatever is seen is you alone.
Recognition declared both ways: seen as self, homage to you and to me.
Method questioned to its root: instrument, place, origin of dissolving.
Non-duality asserted, difference explained as the wish to grasp samādhi.
Speech finds no room: if even I-and-you-talk cannot stay, whence a world of words.
Enough of difference-talk: devotion chewed to sap leaves all as one, at peace.
Expansion holds you-me-world; withdrawal holds none.
States held as own rays: shining by own will like an actor, partless in truth.

rasa.justification: Riddle after riddle with no softening; the vigor is in the asking (who, what, whence), never in assertion. Stillness argued into view.

sections.SUMMARY: Homage to the world-formed beyond the world, ever-shining self of unending power. You alone, I alone; you are, I am not; both are not — only homage. Seeking finds no self to see: whatever is seen is you alone. Recognition declared both ways: seen as self, homage to you and to me. Method questioned to its root: instrument, place, origin of dissolving. Non-duality asserted, difference explained as the wish to grasp samādhi. Speech finds no room: if even I-and-you-talk cannot stay, whence a world of words. Enough of difference-talk: devotion chewed to sap leaves all as one, at peace. Expansion holds you-me-world; withdrawal holds none. States held as own rays: shining by own will like an actor, partless in truth.
sections.FUNCTION: Poses identity as riddles, then dissolves the instruments of knowing one by one.
sections.KEY TERMS: prapañcottīrṇa (beyond-the-world as what is bowed to); tvam/aham/ubhau (you/I/both as refused positions); gaveṣita (sought-and-never-seen); samprekṣya (having-seen as recognition); kalana (measuring as what is questioned); samādhi-grahaṇecchā (wish-to-grasp as difference's only ground); vāc (words as roomless); carvaṇa (chewing as devotion's act); unmatta? no — see v12; naṭavat (actor-like, print naTavan kept).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Maṅgala and riddles passed; method, duality, speech, and devotion questioned; expansion and states surveyed.
sections.BOUNDARY: No practice enjoined yet; asking and refusing stand without instruction.
sections.EXPLANATION: Homage opens beyond the world-form to the shining self of unending power. Then the riddles: you alone, I alone, both — each tried and left, till only homage stands. Seeking inside finds no self to see, only you as whatever is seen. Recognition, once declared, honors both sides. Method itself is interrogated at its root. Duality survives only as the wish to grasp samādhi. Speech cannot stay, so whence a world of words. Enough of difference-talk: devotion chewed to sap is oneness at peace. Your expansion holds all three; your withdrawal holds none. The states are yours, held as rays, shone at will like an actor — and partless in truth.

Bath, garment, scent, jewel questioned: none for stainless, world-full, unanointed, lovely.
Thread, flowers, incense, lamp questioned: each without a receiver.
Food, betel, circling, bowing questioned: all without a needy recipient.
Lights, hymn questioned: waving-lights for self-shining, hymn for unspeakable.
Sending-off, oblation questioned: no going out for the full, no difference for the fire.

Highest worship is nondual mind yoked to the Lord of all, in every state, always.

rasa.dominant: śānta settling into sthiti (stillness settling into establishment)
rasa.justification: Nineteen negations of rite, then one affirmation of yoking: the kutaḥ barrage clears every prop until only holding remains.

sections.SUMMARY: Derived waking and sleep: his waking yours, his rest yours — all of your nature, real-unreal. Rites exhausted at the start: tired tongue, tired mind — meditation with no form, name with no quality. Summoning, seating, washing, sipping questioned: each without place or receiver. Bath, garment, scent, jewel questioned: none for stainless, world-full, unanointed, lovely. Thread, flowers, incense, lamp questioned: each without a receiver. Food, betel, circling, bowing questioned: all without a needy recipient. Lights, hymn questioned: waving-lights for self-shining, hymn for unspeakable. Sending-off, oblation questioned: no going out for the full, no difference for the fire. Fee, drink, dismissal, pardon questioned: none owed where full, content, everywhere, unseen. sections.FUNCTION: Runs the kutaḥ battery across every rite, then answers all of it with one yoking.
sections.KEY TERMS: kutaḥ (whence/wherefore as the whole method); naṭavat (actor-like, print naTavan kept); sadasat (real-unreal as derived world); niyojayet (let-yoke as the single imperative); aikyabuddhi (nondual mind as the only instrument).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Identity riddles done, states surveyed: derivation declared, rites exhausted one by one, then yoked mind answers all.
sections.BOUNDARY: No rite is retained; the single imperative (yoke) is not a rite among rites.
sections.EXPLANATION: Waking and sleep are derived before a single rite is named: his waking is yours, his rest is yours — the world that results is real-and-unreal. Then exhaustion up front: tired tongue, tired mind, and the questions begin — meditation for the formless, names for the qualityless, and on through every implement: summoning, seating, washing, sipping, bathing, clothing, scenting, jeweling, threading, flowering, smoking, lighting, feeding, betelling, circling, bowing, waving, hymning, dismissing, burning, paying, pouring, pardoning. None finds a receiver. Then the turn that answers nineteen negations: with nondual mind, yoke mind to the Lord of all — in every state, always. That is the highest worship.

lines: Homage to the world-formed, past the world — to ever-shining divinity, to self of unending power.
You, you alone; I, I alone. You alone are; I, nowise. You and I, both — where is homage, homage, homage?
mpa-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: tvaṃ tvamevāhamevāhaṃ tvamevāsi na cāsmyaham | ahaṃ tvamityubhau na sto yatra tasmai namo namaḥ

lines: Sought within the body by me always — you as self, yet the self unseen. Seen, whatever is — you alone, that.
mpa-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: antardehe mayā nityaṃ tvamātmā ca gaveṣitaḥ | na dṛṣṭastvaṃ nacaivātmā yacca dṛṣṭaṃ tvameva tat

lines: Of your devotee, who knows your form well, now again —
having seen you as the self's own shape: homage to you, homage to me.
mpa-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktasya sajñātabhavadrūpasyatha me punaḥ | tvāmātmarūpaṃ samprekṣya tubhyaṃ mahyaṃ namo namaḥ

lines: What knack of going, what to be done, and so, from the root?
Of you, magic-natured: by what, in what — whence the melt?
mpa-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: etadgacananaipuṇyaṃ yatkartavyetimūlayā | bhavanmāyātmanastasya kena kasmin kuto layaḥ

lines: I, you; you, I — so no twoness of us anywhere.
Mere wish to seize samādhi: that is all the abiding of split is.
mpa-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ tvaṃ tvamahaṃ ceti bhinnatā nāvayoḥ kvacit | samādhigrahaṇecchāyā bhedasyāvasthitirhyasau

lines: You-and-I and the rest — so unending, always in you, they get no place.
Talk, then — from where the world?
mpa-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: tvamahaṃ so'yamityādi so'nantāni sadā tvayi | na labhante cāvakāśaṃ vacanāni kuto jagat

lines: No more of difference-talk. From chewing devotion's sap for you —
all this one, at peace, though saying so is shy.
mpa-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: alaṃ bhedānukathayā tvadbhaktirasacarvaṇāt | sarvamekamidaṃ śāntamiti vaktuṃ ca lajjate

lines: When your own shape swells — you, I, and the whole world.
When its hiding is born — no you, no I, no world indeed.
mpa-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: tvatsvarūpe jṛmbhamāṇe tvaṃ cāhaṃ cākhilaṃ jagat | jāte tasya tirodhāne na tvaṃ nāhaṃ na vai jagat

lines: Wake-world, dream, deep sleep, and the rest — held as rays of yours;
by own will you beam like an actor, yet partless in fact.
mpa-p01-v10.sanskrit_cite: jāgratasvapnasuṣuptyādyā dhārayaṃśca nijāḥ kalāḥ | svecchayā bhāsi naṭavan niṣkalo'si ca tattvataḥḥ

lines: His waking from yours, his sleep from yours;
Hence everything of your nature: the world, real-and-not.
mpa-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: tvatprabodhāt prabodho'sya tvannidrāto layo'sya yat | atastvadātmakaṃ sarvaṃ viśva sadasadātmakam

lines: Tongue weary of your name, mind weary of your recall.
Formless one — what meditation? Qualityless — what name?
mpa-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: jihvā śrāntā bhavannāmni manaḥ śrāntaṃ bhavatsmṛtau | arūpasya kuto dhyāna nirguṇasya ca nāma kim

lines: For the full, whence the call? For the all-homed, whence a seat?
For the clean, foot-water and honors? For the pure, sipping?
mpa-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasyāvāhanaṃ kutra sarvādhārasya cāsanam | svacchasya pādyamarghyañca śuddhasyācamanaṃ kutaḥ

lines: For the stainless, what bathing? For the world-wombed, what robe?
For the unsmeared, what scent? For the fair, what gem?
mpa-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: nirmalasya kutaḥ snānaṃ vastraṃ viśvodarasya ca | nirlepasya kuto gandho ramyasyābharaṇaṃ kutaḥ

lines: Thread for the propless, blooms for the wishless.
Noseless, take incense; eyeless, take lamp — to what use?
mpa-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: nirālambasyopavītaṃ puṣpaṃ nirvāsanasya ca | aghrāṇasya kuto dhūpaścakṣurhīnasya dīpakaḥ

lines: Food for the ever-full, betel for the Lord — from where?
Circling for the boundless, bowing for the non-twain — from where?
mpa-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: nityatṛptasya naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca kuto vibhoḥ | pradakṣiṇamanantasyā'dvitīyasyaya kuto natiḥ

lines: Whence lamp-waving for the self-lit Lord?
How is song enjoined for the unsayable by Veda?
mpa-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: svayaṃ prakāśamānasya kuto nīrājanaṃ vibhoḥ | vedavācāmavedyasya kutaḥ stotraṃ vidhīyate

lines: How farewell for the full, within and without?
And how burnt-gift for the partless, everywhere?
mpa-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: antarbahiśca pūrṇasya kathamudvāsanaṃ bhavet | bhedahīnasya viśvatra kathaṃ ca havanaṃ bhavet

lines: Fee where for the full? For the ever-content, what libation?
For the ever-content, what drink-offering?
mpa-p02-v19.sanskrit_cite: pūrṇasya dakṣiṇā kutra nityatṛptasya tarpaṇam | visarjanaṃ vyāpakasyā'pratyakṣasya kṣamāpaṇam

lines: So indeed: supreme worship, in every state, at all times —
with undivided mind, yoke mind to the Lord as All-Lord.
mpa-p02-v20.sanskrit_cite: evameva parā pūjā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā | aikyabuddhayā tu sarveśe mano deve niyojayet

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: maṅgala bow (FIRST-VERSE voice: plain, declarative, end-weighted homage; sets house voice — owner verdict required). Sanskrit: prapañcottīrṇarūpāya namaste...svātmane'nantaśaktaye → L4 keeps bow-past-world-shining-self arc. Rows: row 2 (shining→bow). Close: bow (namas as landing, doubled). Rejected: 'worship' for homage — kept bow (namas as bending, not rite); 'transcendent' — kept past-the-world (uttīrṇa as crossed-beyond).

reads_against.argmap: What is first worshipped? → The maṅgala names its object twice: the formed world transcended, the shining self whose power does not end.
c1_essence: Homage to the world-formed beyond the world, ever-shining self of unending power.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness carrying debate-fire)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: identity riddles (you-alone/I-alone/both-not). Rows: row 2 (am-not→homage). Close: homage (thrice — the question dissolves into bowing). Rejected: 'only you, only I' smoothing — kept alone-thrice (eva hammered); answering the riddle — kept unanswered (questions ARE the verse).

reads_against.argmap: Who are you, who am I? → Identity and non-identity both refused: neither you alone nor I alone, nor both — only homage where the question lands.
c1_essence: You alone, I alone; you are, I am not; both are not — only homage.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness carrying debate-fire)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: sought-unseen (whatever seen is you). Rows: row 2 (unseen→that). Close: that (tad as landing: THAT is you). Rejected: 'meditation' — kept sought (gaveṣita as searching, not sitting); 'everything is you' flat — kept whatever-is-seen (the seen, not all).

reads_against.argmap: What is found inside? → Seeking finds no self to see: whatever is seen is you alone — the sought turns out to be the seer.
c1_essence: Seeking finds no self to see: whatever is seen is you alone.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness carrying debate-fire)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: both-ways homage (knower and known honored). Rows: row 2 (seen→homage). Close: me (mahyaṃ as landing: homage ends at ME too). Rejected: 'disciple' for devotee — kept devotee (bhakta precise); 'realize' for seen — kept seen (samprekṣya as beheld).

reads_against.argmap: What does the devotee declare? → Recognition declared both ways: seen as self, homage goes to you and to me — knower and known each honored.
c1_essence: Recognition declared both ways: seen as self, homage to you and to me.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness carrying debate-fire)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: method-questioned (instrument/place/origin asked). Rows: row 2 (root→melt?). Close: melt (laya as landing). Rejected: 'how to meditate' how-to — kept knack (naipuṇya as finesse, not manual); 'liberation' for dissolving — kept melt (laya as event).

reads_against.argmap: What finesse remains? → Method questioned to its root: given your magic-nature, what instrument, what place, what origin could dissolving have.
c1_essence: Method questioned to its root: instrument, place, origin of dissolving.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness carrying debate-fire)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: no-twoness (wish alone divides). Rows: row 2 (nowhere→split). Close: split (bheda as landing: the split IS the sentence's end). Rejected: 'nonduality' named — kept no-twoness (the verse denies, never names); 'desire' for wish — kept wish (icchā precise).

reads_against.argmap: Is there duality? → Non-duality asserted, difference explained away: what looks like abiding difference is only the wish to grasp samādhi.
c1_essence: Non-duality asserted, difference explained as the wish to grasp samādhi.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness carrying debate-fire)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: roomless words (talk finds no place). Rows: row 1 (unending→no-place). Close: world? (jagat as landing: whence the WORLD). Rejected: 'inexpressible' — kept no-place-found (avakāśa as room, spatial); 'maya' gloss — kept rest (ādi as and-the-rest, unexpanded).

reads_against.argmap: Where do words go? → Speech finds no room in you: if even I-and-you-talk cannot stay, whence a world of words.

reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness carrying debate-fire)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: enough-talk (devotion chewed to peace). Rows: row 1 (enough→sap). Close: shy (lajjate as landing: shyness closes even the closing). Rejected: 'silence' — kept shy (the verse speaks its shyness); 'love' for devotion — kept devotion (bhakti precise).

reads_against.argmap: What is enough? → Enough of talking difference: devotion chewed to sap leaves all as one, at peace — and even saying so is shy.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: swell-and-hide (all held, all dropped). Rows: row 2 (hide→world?). Close: indeed (vai as landing: the neither-neither sealed). Rejected: 'creation/destruction' — kept swell/hide (jāti/tirodhāna as play, not cosmology); 'everyone' for all — kept world (jagat).

reads_against.argmap: What when you expand, what when you withdraw? → Expansion holds all three; withdrawal holds none: being and nonbeing of you, me, world turn on your play.

reads_against.argmap: Whose is all this? → Waking and sleep derived: his waking yours, his rest yours — hence all is of your nature, real-and-unreal.
